title: WHEN THE NORTH JOINS AGAINST YOU

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: When Jabin king of Hazor heard of this, he sent word to Jobab king of Madon, to the kings of Shimron and Akshaph, and to the northern kings who were in the mountains, in the Arabah south of Kinnereth, in the western foothills and in Naphoth Dor on the west - Josh 11:1-2 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
The southern kings had already fallen, and now the news travels north. Jabin of Hazor hears what God has been doing through Israel, and instead of bowing, he gathers allies. It is a picture we know well. When God begins to work in a life, opposition does not always shrink — sometimes it organises itself and grows louder.

Notice that Jabin's response to hearing about God is to resist Him. The same truth that softens one heart can harden another. That is not a comfortable thought, but Scripture is honest about it. Pharaoh heard and hardened; the Canaanite kings heard and gathered their armies. Hearing about God is never neutral; it always asks something of us.

For you and me, the encouragement here is quiet but real. If following the Lord has stirred up resistance in your life, you are not off course. The kings gathered precisely because God was moving. Jesus told His followers plainly that the world would push back (John 15:18-19). Opposition is not proof that God has abandoned you — often it is proof that He is at work.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- When have you noticed resistance grow just as God was doing something in your life?
- Does opposition tempt you to think you have taken a wrong turn?
- How does knowing Christ warned us of this steady your heart today?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, when resistance gathers against me, help me not to panic or assume I have failed You. Steady my heart in the truth that You are still at work. Amen.
